notes: Includes mandatory employee payroll deductions that apply in Canada: federal/provincial income tax (placeholder - use CRA tables), Canada Pension Plan (CPP) employee portion (except Quebec), Employment Insurance (EI) employee premiums. Quebec uses QPP and different EI rates; QPP info included under subnational 'Quebec'. Only mandatory employee deductions are modelled here.

contributions.label: Canada Pension Plan (CPP) - employee
contributions.notes: Employee portion of CPP (2025). Employers must also match this amount. Use annual YMPE and exemption when calculating.

contributions.label: Employment Insurance (EI) - employee
contributions.notes: Employee EI premium (2025) outside Quebec; employer pays a higher rate.

Quebec.notes: Quebec administers QPP and has different rates for pension and EI. Employers in Quebec remit to Revenu Québec for provincial portions.

contributions.label: Québec Pension Plan (QPP) - employee
contributions.notes: Employee portion of QPP (2025). An additional contribution may apply for earnings between YMPE and additional YMPE; see sources.

sources.document_title: Canada Revenue Agency - Payroll deductions and remittances

subnational.disclaimer: This dataset models the primary mandatory federal employee deductions for Canada and Quebec specifics under subnational. Income tax withholding is jurisdiction- and credit-dependent and should use CRA/Provincial tables for accurate withholding amounts. Verify against official sources before relying on results.
